use_cases: Primary call-to-action for AI-powered generate actions and content creation workflows
Interactive button for triggering machine learning or AI inference features
Highlighted action buttons in SaaS dashboards requiring visual emphasis
Creative tool interfaces needing branded button interactions with sparkle accents
Onboarding flows or feature announcements requiring attention-grabbing button states
ai_summary: A minimalist atomic button component featuring a glowing visual effect with sparkle iconography. The button includes click state management with immediate visual feedback through a 200ms active state transition. Designed as a primary CTA for AI-powered features, content generation tools, and creative SaaS applications requiring engaging interactive elements with subtle animation.
